questions: Can one student borrow more than one copy of the same book at the same time, and is there a limit on how many books one student can have out?
Should students and the librarian log in with a password, or is it enough that a student just types their name (what if two students have the same name)?
Does the librarian also need to edit or remove a book, or change the number of copies later, and should there be a due date for returning books?
answers: No, they just give their name.
